note: Two conditions meant to be combined with somebody else's creatures. A conditions-only pack is a legitimate shape: it publishes vocabulary for other packs to apply.

conditions.name: pale-orchard-graft-taken
conditions.description: A cutting from the orchard has taken root under the skin. It does not hurt yet.
unmodelled: Over a season the grafted creature becomes part of the orchard
No flags on purpose: the graft is a campaign clock, not a combat penalty

conditions.name: pale-orchard-blossom-drunk
conditions.description: Orchard pollen. The creature is entirely certain of itself and entirely wrong.
